name: Arkansas Championship 2026
information: This competition is supported by [Southern Cubing](https://southerncubing.com/) as the Arkansas State Championship for 2026! While only residents of Arkansas are eligible for the title of Arkansas State Champion, all competitors are welcome and encouraged to compete! More information can be found on the [Arkansas Champion Titles](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ArkansasChampionship2025#52514-arkansas-champion-titles) tab. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTUxMjY0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ba8cf400c90970b89cbba5cfb8075de64f93272e/image.png) To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NTA5ODQsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d90b474725899b23c9c5d15d90dc03063159a03c/southernCubing.png)
